items.title: Special Weather Statement issued April 13 at 6:27AM CDT by NWS Bismarck ND
items.summary:
Areas of fog will reduce the visibility to one quarter mile in
parts of southwest North Dakota this morning. Motorists should be
prepared for rapidly changing visibilities, and should use extra
caution traveling. Use low beam headlights and be extra cautious
at intersections and railroad crossings.

The fog is expected to dissipate mid to late morning.

items.title: Special Weather Statement issued April 13 at 6:17AM CDT by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
items.summary:
Fog has developed across portions of eastern Iowa and could
become locally dense with visibilities down to a quarter mile at
times. If you are headed out early this morning, be prepared for
rapid changes in visibility over short distances and keep plenty
of stopping distance in front of you. The fog will dissipate by
the mid morning.
